loadFailed: The till could not be loaded
noBranchHint: Ask an administrator to give you access to a branch.

open.title: Open your till
open.hint: Count the cash in the drawer and enter it as the opening float.
open.noDevice: No till is registered at this branch. Ask a manager to add one.
open.floatHint: Cash already in the drawer. Use 0 if it is empty.

products.title: Products
products.search: Search or scan: name, SKU or barcode
products.scanHint: Press Enter to add. Arrow keys move through results. F2 or / jumps here.
products.several: Several products match. Tap the right one.
products.noPrice: {{name}} has no price and you may not set one.
products.refine: Showing the first results. Type to narrow the list.

cart.title: Sale
cart.emptyHint: Scan a barcode or tap a product to start.
cart.clearMessage: All items are removed from the cart.

line.noListPrice: No list price: enter the price
line.noPermission: You may not change prices or give discounts. Ask a manager.

problem.quantity: Quantity must be more than zero.
problem.price: Enter a price for this item.
problem.reason: Choose a reason for the price change or discount.
problem.discount: The discount is more than the line.

hold.title: Held sales
hold.emptyHint: Use Hold to park a sale while the customer fetches something.

pay.title: Take payment
pay.pickMethod: Choose how the customer pays. You can split between methods.
pay.creditHint: Added to {{name}}'s account. Their credit limit and terms are checked.

problem.short: The payments do not cover the total yet.
problem.overpaid: Only cash can be more than the total. Lower the card, mobile or credit amount.
problem.code: Enter the mobile money code, or send a prompt to the customer's phone.
problem.customer: Attach a customer to sell on account.
problem.waiting: Waiting for the customer to approve the mobile money prompt.

pay.retrySafe: Nothing was lost. Press Try again: the sale will be recorded only once, even if the first attempt went through.
pay.fixAndRetry: Fix this and press Try again. The cart is unchanged.

mobile.sendSafe: The customer is not prompted twice if you try again.
mobile.waiting: Waiting for the customer to approve on their phone…
mobile.pollError: Cannot check the prompt right now. Still trying…
mobile.codeHint: Or type the code from the customer's confirmation message.

status.failed: The payment failed or was declined.

done.title: Sale complete
done.receiptFailed: The receipt could not be loaded

close.title: Close your till
close.cartOpen: Finish or clear the current sale first.
close.heldLost: {{count}} held sale(s) will be discarded when the till closes.
close.countedHint: Count the drawer, including the float.
close.final: Closing cannot be undone. Start a new till to keep selling.
close.heldExpired: {{count}} held sale(s) ended with the till.

sync.open: Show sales waiting to be sent
sync.title: Sales on this till
sync.statusOnline: Connected. Sales made without a connection are sent in the order they were made. Waiting: {{count}}.
sync.statusOffline: No connection. Sales are saved on this device and sent when it returns. Waiting: {{count}}.
sync.noStorage: This browser cannot keep sales on this device. Without a connection you cannot sell here. Use a normal (not private) window, or another browser.
sync.oldWarning: Some sales have been waiting for more than a day. Connect this device so they can be sent.
sync.largeWarning: {{count}} sales are waiting to be sent. Connect this device soon so they can be sent.
sync.emptyHint: Every sale has reached the server.
sync.refused: The server did not accept this sale: {{reason}} A manager can see it under Exceptions. Copy the details if the sale must be entered again.
sync.retrying: Could not send yet ({{reason}}). Will try again.
sync.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy the text by hand.
sync.removeTitle: Remove this sale from the list?
sync.removeMessage: {{number}} will no longer be listed here. Only do this after copying its details: the server did not record it.

warning.price_changed: The price changed since this was sold ({{detail}}). The customer paid the price on the receipt.
warning.closed_day: The trading day of this sale was already closed, so it was booked today.
warning.till_closed: The till had already been closed when this sale arrived.
warning.mobile_money_without_code: A mobile money payment has no code.
warning.unauthorised_override: A price or discount was changed without permission or a reason ({{detail}}).
warning.over_credit_limit: The customer went over their credit limit ({{detail}}).

sync.neverLoaded: This till has never been opened on this device with a connection. Connect once so it can be loaded.
sync.openNeedsConnection: A new till can only be opened with a connection. Connect this device, then open the till.
sync.mayBeOld: This copy is old: check prices.
sync.noCopy: No product list is saved on this device yet. Connect once so it can be loaded.
sync.noStorageSale: No connection, and this browser cannot keep the sale on this device. The sale cannot be made now.
sync.offlineSale: No connection. The sale will be saved on this device and sent when the connection returns. Cash, card slips and mobile money codes can be taken.
sync.creditOffline: Selling on account needs a connection, because the customer's credit limit must be checked.
sync.promptOffline: Prompts to the customer's phone need a connection. Type the code from the customer's confirmation message.
sync.savedHint: It has not reached the server yet. It will be sent when the connection returns. This receipt number is provisional and will be confirmed then.
sync.receiptProvisional: PROVISIONAL RECEIPT: TO BE CONFIRMED. Saved offline.
sync.closeOffline: Closing the till needs a connection.
sync.closeMessage: {{count}} sale(s) have not reached the server yet, so the till's totals are not complete. They are being sent now: wait for the status in the top bar to show Online with nothing waiting, then close. Close anyway only if you cannot wait; they will still be sent afterwards.
sync.offlineBanner: No connection. Sales are saved on this device and sent later.
sync.attentionBanner: {{count}} sale(s) were not accepted by the server and need attention.
sync.saveFailed: The sale could not be saved on this device ({{reason}}). It was not recorded. Free some space or use another browser, then try again.
